title: Portuguese Midnight Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry dish made with juicy chicken, midnight black rice, and a blend of herbs, inspired by traditional Portuguese cuisine.

ingredients.name: fresh herbs (such as parsley or cilantro)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion and sliced bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the soy sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and soy sauce.
Serve the chicken and vegetable mixture over the midnight black rice.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs and serve hot.
